Deep Bhattacharjee, *Unbounded strong-product ratios for the Grundy domination number*. Final revision, single column (amsart), 9 pages.

The paper disproves the conjecture of Brešar, Bujtás, Gologranc, Klavžar, Košmrlj, Patkós, Tuza
and Vizer (2016) that the Grundy domination number of a strong product equals the product of
the Grundy domination numbers of its factors, and shows that the ratio is unbounded. It also
computes the Grundy domination number of the graph H_N (u and v adjacent when |u-v| = 2 mod 3)
for every N >= 6, so that its strong product with the octahedron is a counterexample for N = 19,
on 114 vertices, and for every N >= 21. Every statement is proved by hand. Programs in C and
Python recompute the small cases; this release runs them before publishing. No statement of the
paper rests on them.

This revision replaces the releases v1.2.0 and v1.3.0 of this repository and the earlier and
incomplete version on Hexagon (hexagon:2610.00494); the counterexample was first made public
on 14 October 2026 as release v1.0.0 of creelie/grundy-strong-product.

Files: the paper (`GrundyStrongProduct_final2.pdf`), its LaTeX source with the figures
(`GrundyStrongProduct_final2-tex.zip`) and the arXiv tarball
(`GrundyStrongProduct_final2-arxiv.tar.gz`).

Contact: d.bhattacharjee@erl-forschung.de, itsdeep@live.com; for this repository egspl@proton.me.
